stem:
Riya sees a frog in the pond behind her school and also sitting on the wet grass nearby. She wants to classify this habitat.

What makes the frog's habitat suitable to be called an amphibian habitat?
part of life spent in water	part of life spent on land

teacher.key_rationale: A frog is an amphibian: it spends part of its life in water and part on land, so both features are ✓, giving A. Options B and C trap a student who drops one of the two stated conditions; D drops both. If the habitat (pond or grass) is damaged, the frog loses part of what it needs to survive.
